settings.deleteBody: This removes every receipt and photo, all budgets and saved merchant categories from this phone. Your settings stay. This can’t be undone.

privacy.draft: Draft — the final policy is published before release.
privacy.s1Title: Your receipts stay on your phone
privacy.s1Body: Receipts, photos, budgets and settings are stored on this phone only. Slipbird has no accounts and no cloud sync.
privacy.s2Body: Receipt photos are read on your phone. Only the text found on a receipt is sent to our parser to fill in the fields.
privacy.s3Title: What the parser sees and keeps
privacy.s3Body: The text is passed to an AI service that reads it, and is not stored by Slipbird. We keep only a technical log: an anonymous id, the time, how long the request took and how many tokens it used.
privacy.s4Body: Settings → Delete all data removes everything Slipbird holds on this phone.
